name: team-workbench
description: Native team workbench with reviewed lifecycle hooks, task execution and source-labeled session browsing.

interface.shortDescription: Tasks and team in one place
interface.longDescription: Shared tasks, source-labeled native members, multilevel parent relationships and workflow groups. Reviewed metadata-only hooks update running and idle states. Navigation and continuation require supported host tools and exact-target receipts. Visible history is bounded and lead-mediated. Full GitHub-installed desktop UI acceptance remains unverified.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open the Team Workbench for this task.
